stem:
The net of an equilateral triangular prism and some of its dimensions are shown in the diagram. The height of each triangular base is approximately 5.2 cm.

Which measurement is closest to the lateral surface area of the prism in square centimeters?
visual_elements: Diagram showing the net of an equilateral triangular prism with a triangular base of height 5.2 cm, side length of 6 cm, and a rectangular section labeled 9 cm on the net.
